places.name: Victoria Park
places.description: One of London's oldest public parks, opened in 1845 for the East End.

history.summary: N16 lies within Hackney. Formed in 1965 from Hackney, Shoreditch, and Stoke Newington. Victoria Park, opened in 1845 as one of the first public parks in the East End, straddles Hackney's border with Tower Hamlets.
